## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `test`, `chore`, ...).
- [ ] `uv run nox` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated for the change.
- [ ] A user-visible change is in the changelog page of the version in development: one short
      entry with the issue number.
- [ ] `__version__` is changed only in a release pull request.
